final: WITH account_avg AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), region_avg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.avg_amount) AS figure FROM account_avg aa JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS avg_figure FROM region_avg) SELECT ra.region, ra.figure, ra.figure - o.avg_figure AS excess_over_average, ra.figure / o.avg_figure AS figure_divided_by_average FROM region_avg ra CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ra.figure > o.avg_figure
